title: Civil Site and Project Engineers
content_text:
Civil Site and Project Engineers
Engineering
Civil / Structural / Design
Moreton Bay Region
Permanent | Full Time
25/9/2026
Home Each Night working on local projects in the Moreton Bay Region
Named 5-Star Employer of Choice for excellence in culture & employee experience
Deliver major civil construction projects valued between $5M-$70M.
We are seeking motivated Site Engineers and Project Engineers to join a leading civil contracting company and play a key role in delivering major civil construction projects across the Moreton Bay region, with project values ranging from $5 million to $70 million.
At Shadforth, we provide genuine opportunities for long-term career progression and are committed to supporting the professional development and growth of our people.
Working closely with the Project Manager, you will be involved in the day-to-day delivery of projects, coordinating activities and ensuring works are completed efficiently and in line with contractual obligations, quality standards and safety requirements.
key responsibilities will be:
Conduct daily site inspections and oversee onsite teams and plant, including subcontractors
Manage construction planning, programming, and completion schedules
Procurement and allocation of necessary project resources
Cost tracking and reporting to Project Manager
Quality Assurance documentation
Contract Administration, including NODs/EOTs, notices, reporting, claims
What's in it for you?
Local work |  Enjoy the benefit of returning home each night, giving you more quality time with your family.
Job Stability |  Leading civil contractor with ongoing pipeline of works  that are shaping cities and communities
Career Progression |  Access to people and leaders to support and guide you through your career
Supportive Environment |  Work with skilled Supervisors who appreciate and acknowledge your efforts.
Wellness Programs |  Regular programs offering Wellness and Awareness initiatives co-designed amongst the Shadforth Teams
Diversity & Inclusion |  committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace
About Us
Shadforth are one of Queensland’s largest family-owned civil construction companies originating on the Sunshine Coast over 60 years ago. We have a strong presence across Queensland and Northern New South Wales where we have developed an outstanding reputation working across many sectors including residential and commercial subdivisions and major civil infrastructure, including roads and bridges.
To Apply
Click 'apply now' to submit an up-to-date copy of your resume and a covering letter highlighting your experience.
Shadforth is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Check out our website for other career opportunities - www.shadcivil.com.au
